versions.subject: Lolbin
versions.detection:
lolbin:
    Image|endswith: '\ie4uinit.exe'
filter_correct:
    CurrentDirectory:
        - 'c:\windows\system32\'
        - 'c:\windows\sysWOW64\'
filter_missing: 
    CurrentDirectory: null
condition: lolbin and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\ie4uinit.exe" NOT (CurrentDirectory IN ("c:\\windows\\system32\\", "c:\\windows\\sysWOW64\\") OR NOT CurrentDirectory=*)
